app.title: ACIEE Advisor
app.tagline: Course survival guides and anonymous professor evaluations

home.title: What each course really asks of you,
home.titleMark: told by students who passed it.
home.lede: Anonymous student ratings and tips on courses and professors, next to your group's timetable. Anyone can read them. You only need an account to rate.
home.pendingBody: Your answers stay anonymous, and you can change them later.

catalog.title: Every course in your plan
catalog.body: Pick your specialization and year to see each semester’s courses and their hours.

survival.title: How to pass
survival.body: How hard the exam is, how much the lab helps, how strict attendance is. Plus tips from classmates.

professors.title: Professors, criterion by criterion
professors.body: A radar chart for each subject they teach, drawn from student ratings.

timetable.title: Your group's timetable
timetable.body: From the official PDF, laid out by day, odd and even weeks sorted out. No account needed.

groups.title: Your group
groups.body: Join with your group leader’s link and you can rate the courses you take.

control.title: Your ratings stay yours
control.body: See what you submitted, then change it or delete it whenever you want.

home.anonTitle: A rating is never tied to your account
home.anonLede: The questionnaire uses blind signatures, the same idea as a sealed ballot envelope: we can check that a vote is valid without knowing whose it is.

account.title: You sign in as a student
account.body: Your {'@'}student.ugal.ro address and your group decide which courses you can rate.

token.title: Your browser gets a signed token
token.body: For each course, the server signs a token it never sees. Later it cannot tell which account the token came from.

submit.title: The rating is sent without your account
submit.body: It travels with the token only. One token means one rating per course.

recovery.title: You keep a recovery code
recovery.body: With it you can edit or delete your rating from any device. We cannot recover the code for you.

home.anonNote: Comments and tips are published after moderation. Averages appear only once enough students have rated a course.
home.closingTitle: Passed a course? Tell next year’s students what it was like.
home.closingBody: All it takes is an account with your university address.

hints.academic_year: Start here each autumn: one row per academic year, from its first day to the day before the next one starts.
hints.semester: The two semesters of a year with their vacations. Odd/even weeks and the calendar feed are counted from these dates.
hints.study_group: One row per group and year (for example 22C31). Then use “Generate the group's courses” to copy its subjects from the plan.
hints.subgroup: The halves of a group (A, B) that labs and seminars are split into.
hints.course_offering: The courses a group takes this year. Usually generated from the group, edited here only for exceptions.
hints.teaching_assignment: Who teaches what: a professor, a group course and a component (lecture, seminar, lab), optionally for one subgroup.
hints.leaders: Approve students who ask to lead a group, and revoke leaders.
hints.professor: Teachers shown on course and professor pages. Archive instead of deleting someone who has left.
hints.department: Departments within a faculty. Rarely changes.
hints.specialization: Study programmes such as Calculatoare. Rarely changes.
hints.subject: Every subject that appears in any plan, by its official code.
hints.study_plan: A curriculum for one programme and the years of admission it applies to.
hints.curriculum_item: The subjects of a plan, by year and semester, with their weekly hours.
hints.history: Every change made in admin, who made it and when.
hints.reports: Aggregated rating results, exportable for the faculty.
